pages.text: [#](53341a)A familiar is not merely a tame animal — it is a companion bound to you through ritual, carrying part of your craft onward after the binding is done.[#]()
pages.title: Familiars

pages.text: [#](53341a)You may have one at a time. Tame the creature, then perform the Rite of Familiar Binding.[#]()
[#](53341a)The binding also leaves it strangely resilient to fire, falls, and drowning.[#]()

pages.name: The Owl
pages.text: [#](53341a)Reads the air and warns of what approaches. At full speed on a broomstick, an owl grants a significant bonus — they seem to enjoy the height.[#]()

pages.name: The Cat
pages.text: [#](53341a)Indifferent to most things, hostile to supernatural intrusion. Curses find less purchase near a cat, and your own circle malice takes deeper root.[#]()

pages.name: The Toad
pages.text: [#](53341a)Patient, damp, and helpful to a brewer. It gathers what falls, coaxes the odd extra bottle from the kettle, and strengthens brews you drink yourself.[#]()
